conditional.title: Mali visa-unless-exempt baseline with unpublished nationality schedule
conditional.summary: Mali's law and current border-police guidance require a visa unless an exemption applies and authorize issuance through immigration services or delegated diplomatic and consular agents. The public authorities reviewed do not publish a complete current exemption list or an exhaustive nationality allocation between advance and exceptional border issuance, so these residual relationships cannot safely be assigned one exact rank-grade status.
conditions: The ordinary foreign non-immigrant baseline is a visa unless a separately established exemption applies.
Immigration services may issue entry visas; delegated diplomatic and consular agents issue only within their residence jurisdiction.
The New Delhi mission's digital workflow is an application and mission-routing process, not proof of electronic visa issuance for every nationality.
Existing exact exemptions and individual arrival or advance-visa findings remain governed by their direct official evidence; this record covers only the residual set.
